audience: Classmates and instructors who know basic network concepts
primaryUse: Step through one technical argument and inspect individual characters

theme.palette: paper-grid-ink; red and blue remain reserved for degree semantics
theme.typography: Bricolage Grotesque, Source Serif 4, IBM Plex Mono

interaction.controls: persistent Back/Next bar plus direct stage buttons and keyboard arrows
interaction.selection: node click or keyboard-accessible character list updates a concise facts panel

constraints: Keep the existing site header, footer, grid, and semantic color rules
Use real exported data; do not calculate layouts or null models in the browser
Keep each stage to one claim and one primary action
Respect reduced-motion and provide a readable non-WebGL fallback
